message: Ukrainian-only letter (і ї є ґ) in a Russian string: write the Russian letter (STYLE 16.4); the Russian text is never copied from the Ukrainian draft.
The letter ё is not used (STYLE 16.4): write е (Microsoft Russian practice), also in всё -> все.

Quote marks are guillemets «…» (STYLE 16.3); a straight or English quote, or a low-high quote, is not used. Rephrase instead of nesting. Exempt: a straight quote inside code (="value" or =' as in /key="value") and the literal list of forbidden file-name characters (? " < >).

No space before a colon, semicolon, question mark, exclamation mark, comma or period (STYLE 16.3); write Метка: not Метка :. Exempt: a colon or question mark that is a literal character in the forbidden file-name list (\ : * ?), recognised by the backslash or asterisk before the space.
A hyphen between spaces is not a dash: write the em dash — (U+2014) with a space on each side, or the en dash – (U+2013) in a range (STYLE 16.3).
Write one ellipsis character … (U+2026), never three periods or two ellipses (STYLE 1.2).
Digits are ASCII 0-9 only (STYLE 1.2).
A decimal comma: numbers keep the English point (0.65, D-05); digit grouping is 1,000, not 1 000.
A Cyrillic letter or a hyphenated ending glued to a {placeholder}: a placeholder takes no ending or suffix (STYLE 16.5); put a noun before it (файл {file}) and rephrase.
A Cyrillic letter or hyphen glued before a {placeholder}: separate it with a space or a noun (запись {record}) (STYLE 16.5).
Informal ты form: the UI addresses the user with вы and the plural imperative, or leaves the subject out (STYLE 16.2).
Capital Вы/Ваш in mid-sentence: write вы/ваш in lower case (STYLE 16.2).
Singular imperative (ты form): instructions use the plural imperative with вы (Нажмите, Выберите, Измените) (STYLE 16.2).
Retired slang or calque (STYLE 16.1 Never): write нажать for click, элемент for feature, запись for record, трек for track, пользователь for user, сбросить for reset, конфигурация for config.
Session is сеанс (Microsoft, glossary Session), not сессия.
Feature is элемент (glossary Feature), not признак or особенность; keep these only for their own meaning.
Accession is номер доступа (glossary Accession); not аксессия, учетный, регистрационный or инвентарный номер.
Write the Latin term locus tag (lower case, not declined); метка локуса and локус-тег are not established (glossary Locus tag).
GC skew stays in English (glossary GC skew); write GC-состав for GC content, not ГЦ.
Strand is цепь (glossary Strand, ru.wikipedia GFF), not нить.
Not линейная / круговая запись for a record of the Linear / Circular diagram: write запись линейной диаграммы; кольцевая запись is only the topology (STYLE 16.1).
A combining mark (stress accent U+0301 or a decomposed й): write NFC text without stress marks (STYLE 16.3).
No "(s)" style plural: a counted sentence is a tn pair with one / few / many forms (STYLE 16.5).
A Latin and a Cyrillic letter side by side: either a look-alike letter in a Latin word (С, а, о, е, р) or a glued word; separate with a space or a hyphen.

English word that STYLE 16.1 never keeps in running text: трек, элемент, слот, предустановка, дорожка, всплывающее окно, по умолчанию, сбросить, запись, легенда, подпись. Identifiers (record=#<position>, <feature hash>) are exempt.
